code_fault_assessment.statement: Exact small-system checks and the isolated method-validation run pass, but they do not exercise the periodic material-specific production path; a production-code defect therefore remains possible.

checks.statement: The formula and exact Lehmann validation gates pass for the implemented kernels.
The isolated method-validation runner completed successfully.

next_discriminating_test.action: Acquire and hash-freeze the complete legitimate supplement, bind every disclosed material parameter to the run contract, then execute one frozen ibDET material shard with convergence and access attestation.
next_discriminating_test.expected_resolution: The source audit will show whether the publication closes the parameter contract; the pilot will then either validate the production path, expose a concrete implementation defect, or establish a measured compute boundary.

next_discriminating_actions: Acquire and hash-freeze the complete legitimate supplement, bind every disclosed material parameter to the run contract, then execute one frozen ibDET material shard with convergence and access attestation.
